ticket.subject: Refund follow-up
ticket.message: I already submitted my refund request last Tuesday. Could you tell me whether it has been processed?

topic.instructions: What is the primary topic of `ticket.message`? Classify the requested information, rather than matching the word refund alone.

refund_eligibility.what: Asks whether a purchase qualifies for a refund or what conditions apply.
refund_eligibility.not_for: A follow-up on a request that has already been submitted.
examples: Can I return an opened item?

refund_status.what: Asks about progress or completion of an existing refund request.
refund_status.not_for: General eligibility conditions before making a request.
examples: When will the approved payment reach my account?

criteria.other: A sufficiently clear request outside the two defined refund topics.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: The message does not identify what information the customer seeks.
